name: c12g-dark-soap-null
description: step C12g: the Deep vents preset in darkness plus a never-drying soap spring in each vent's cold ring (15 R out), ?channels=0, 40 min

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(), R = moire.cells.R, m = Math.min(v.cssW, v.cssH); for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const a = (-90 + 120 * k) * Math.PI / 180, cx = v.cssW / 2 + Math.cos(a) * (0.27 * m + 15 * R), cy = v.cssH / 2 + Math.sin(a) * (0.27 * m + 15 * R); moire.matter.addSpring(cx, cy, 'soap', 1e9); } return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)
